mapper.sql: U.USER_ID AS id, U.LOGIN_ID AS username, LOWER(U.LOGIN_ID) AS usernameKey, U.USER_NAME_HAN AS displayName, U.AUTH_CODE AS packageId, U.PASSWORD_HASH AS passwordHash, (U.USE_IND = 'Y') AS active, U.PWD_VERSION AS credentialVersion
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USERMSTR U WHERE U.LOGIN_ID = #{usernameKey} COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
SELECT FROM USERMSTR U ORDER BY LOWER(U.LOGIN_ID), U.USER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERMSTR U JOIN AUTHMSTR A ON A.AUTH_CODE = U.AUTH_CODE WHERE U.USE_IND = 'Y' AND A.USE_IND = 'Y' AND A.SUPER_ADMIN_IND = 'Y' FOR UPDATE
SELECT A.AUTH_CODE FROM AUTHMSTR A WHERE A.SUPER_ADMIN_IND = 'Y' ORDER BY A.AUTH_CODE FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERMSTR (USER_ID, LOGIN_ID, USER_NAME_HAN, PASSWORD_HASH, AUTH_CODE, USE_IND, PWD_VERSION, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_IP, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_IP, SYS_MUSR_DTTM) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{packageId}, IF(#{active}, 'Y', 'N'), #{credentialVersion}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt}, #{sysUserId}, #{sysIp}, #{sysAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE USERMSTR SET USER_NAME_HAN = #{displayName}, PASSWORD_HASH = #{passwordHash}, AUTH_CODE = #{packageId}, USE_IND = IF(#{active}, 'Y', 'N'), PWD_VERSION = #{credentialVersion}, SYS_MUSR_ID = #{sysUserId}, SYS_MUSR_IP = #{sysIp}, SYS_MUSR_DTTM = #{sysAt} WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
